payload.instruction: Construct one reusable Python method in genome/skills/summary/. Edit only that directory. Preserve all other genome bytes. Use standard library only. Never read outside the workspace. Write SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter, capability.json with exactly this descriptor: {"dependencies": ["python-stdlib"], "effects": ["return", "solution-files"], "entrypoint": "method.py:invoke", "interface": "integer-summary/1", "limits": {"max_output_bytes": 65536, "timeout_ms": 5000}, "schema": "rsi-capability/1"}. Write method.py defining invoke(request). request has exactly interface (the version above), value (finite JSON input), files (public solution slots mapped to UTF-8 text), and context (admitted continuation and development evidence). For task episodes, context has exactly continuation (the original admitted context) and task_digest (the canonical task identity). Read continuation fields inside request["context"]["continuation"]. Return exactly a JSON-compatible object with value (finite JSON result) and files (solution slots mapped to UTF-8 text). Returned file names must be a subset of request.files. Do not guess hidden paths. The fixed child adapter handles serialization. It calls your function unchanged. Use evidence.json for the public objective, method specification and development evidence. Do not claim to have passed independent checks. Explain the procedure in your final message.
